title: Finish the loop
brief:
Three parts arrive one after another, and every one has to go into the **reject bin**.

The program is half written: the **Repeat 3 times** loop already waits for a part and moves down to it. Finish the loop where the note says so: **grab** the part, lift it **straight up**, move to `bin.drop` and **let go**.

This cell uses a different cobot — your positions still work by name.

do.note: Finish here: grab the part, lift it straight up, drop it in the bin

hints: You need four more blocks inside the loop, in this order: Close gripper, Move to pick.approach (straight line), Move to bin.drop, Open gripper.
Lift with a straight line, so the part comes up out of the conveyor without dragging sideways.
